I would like to ask you to illustrate Rino Hyohana, an individual vtuber, this time as well.
I would like to see her in a swimsuit.
I'll leave the composition and pose to you.
If you have a background, I would appreciate it if you could separate the layers and give me a PSD of the background.
I would appreciate it if you could give me a PSD of the background in separate layers if you have one.

We would appreciate it if you could indicate in a separate layer where it is difficult to do so.
We look forward to the opportunity to work with you.
